stemMarkdown: In a 400 m race, A finishes in 20 seconds and B finishes in 30 seconds. By how many metres does A beat B? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: B's speed is $\dfrac{400}{30} = 13.3333$ m/s. When A finishes at 20 s, B has covered $13.3333 \times 20 = 266.6667$ m. A therefore beats B by $133.3333$ m.
